description_short: Drag-and-drop research queue management built right into the research tree. Reorder, start, or remove queued items without ever clearing your queue and starting over.
description_long:
Want to start new research but already have a queue? Without this mod, your only option is to clear everything and rebuild it from scratch, one item at a time.

Research Queue adds a queue management panel directly inside the research tree, so you can reorder, start, or remove items without ever leaving the screen.

Features:
- Drag-and-drop reordering of your research queue
- Start or remove items directly from the queue panel
- See what is actively being researched and its progress
- Feels like a native part of the research tree, not a separate overlay
- Works on existing saves, install and go, no new game required

Safe to remove: the mod uses the game's own queue data and creates no save data of its own. Remove it anytime and your queue stays exactly as-is.
